title: Widgets that send values
summary: Sliders, choosers and toggles that the robot reads.

steps.title: The other direction
steps.say: So far every widget **showed** a value. These **send** one: you change it in Elastic and the robot code reads it, the same way drivers set things before a match.

say.never: Your code only works once it's started. In the Driver Station strip at the bottom, press **Start** and wait until the status says **Running**.
say.bit: Your code only runs once it's built and started. Press Start at the bottom.

hint.never: press Start, then wait for Running.
hint.bit: press Start and wait for Running.

steps.title: Which widget
steps.say: Pick the widget that matches the kind of value.

board.code:
Number Slider         ShooterAngleDegrees   (Min 0, Max 45)
ComboBox Chooser      AutoRoutine
Text Display          AutoDelaySeconds      (Show Submit Button on)
Toggle Button         BrakeModeEnabledButton

steps.title: Add a slider
steps.say: With the robot running, click **Add Widget**, search for **ShooterAngleDegrees**, and drag it onto the grid. Then right-click it, choose **Edit Properties**, and change **Widget Type** to **Number Slider**.

waitFor.hint: add ShooterAngleDegrees as a Number Slider.

steps.title: Set its range
steps.say: Still in Edit Properties on the slider (right-click it and choose Edit Properties if you closed it), set **Min 0** and **Max 45**.

waitFor.hint: open Edit Properties on the slider.

steps.title: Move it
steps.say: Close the dialog, then drag the slider's handle to a new angle. The checkpoint watches the **live** value, so you have to actually move it. This needs the robot to still say Running.

waitFor.hint: drag the slider to a new angle.

steps.title: Submit button
steps.say: Add a second widget the same way: drag **AutoDelaySeconds** onto the grid. Right-click it, choose **Edit Properties**, and turn on **Show Submit Button**. Then type a number and press Enter, and it sends once instead of on every keystroke.

steps.title: Save
steps.say: Elastic doesn't always save right away. With your widgets on the grid, use **File → Save** before you Verify.
